findings.finding: The exchange settings already have an owner and a mechanical fence: each setting's doc comment in packages/envoy/internal/broker/config/config.go, rendered by packages/envoy/cmd/broker-refgen through docs/site/generators/broker-reference.sh, beside the hand-written docs/site/src/content/docs/broker/operate.md. Restating the list in docs/kubernetes.md makes a second copy to rot.

It states what those pages do not say (which caller presents what, what an issued token carries, what a deployment that configures none of it gets) and points at the broker's pages by plain path, which docs/kubernetes.md already does at :4805.

The root cannot push to that repository, since its own repository is sjawhar/legion.
